bugs.description: Off-by-one starvation threshold (> instead of >=): boost kicks in one cycle late, so the worst-case chain pushes a wait counter to LIMIT+3, violating the bound. Needs ~11 cycles of sustained contention.

description: 4-client fixed-priority arbiter with per-client starvation counters and anti-starvation boost; bounded wait encoded as a safety property (wait_i <= LIMIT+2).
